items.title: API surface diff triage (api_schema.json vs v1 scope)
items.next_action: Diff all routes in api_schema.json against pentest_scope_v1.md Section 3.1. Produce api_surface_diff_v1_v2.md with net-new routes, auth requirement, HTTP method, and suggested test priority.
items.done_when: docs/security/api_surface_diff_v1_v2.md exists and covers every route present in api_schema.json but absent from v1 Section 3.1.

items.title: Security remediation plan triage (pre- vs post-pentest)
items.next_action: Read SECURITY_REMEDIATION_PLAN.md and SECURITY_STATUS_REPORT.md. Identify all unresolved items. Classify each as pre-pentest (must fix before engagement) or post-pentest. Output to docs/security/remediation_triage.md.
items.done_when: docs/security/remediation_triage.md exists and all unresolved items are classified.
items.aurora_notes: Prevents wasting engagement budget on known-open items. Pre-pentest items should be promoted to CRITICAL and tracked against Section 2.1.

items.title: R&D API surface review + auth audit
items.next_action: For each route in RD_API_REFERENCE.md: confirm auth requirement, flag no-auth/weak-auth/unclear-isolation routes. Output to docs/security/rd_api_auth_audit.md.
items.done_when: docs/security/rd_api_auth_audit.md exists and flags all routes against pentest_scope_v2.md Section 3.7 criteria.
items.aurora_notes: R&D surface was entirely absent from v1. Treat it as a fresh trust boundary — assume nothing about auth until verified. Any route that can reach production data or ethics state is a finding regardless of labelling.

items.title: QGIA ingestion path implementation review
items.next_action: Map current codebase against all 7 QGIA test objectives in pentest_scope_v2.md Section 3.8. For each: identify code path, flag gap, or mark not-yet-implemented. Output to docs/security/qgia_ingestion_review.md.
items.done_when: docs/security/qgia_ingestion_review.md exists with each Section 3.8 objective mapped to a code path, a gap finding, or a not-yet-implemented status.
items.aurora_notes: QGIA is an external L1 advisory source — not an L2 simulation construct. Any code path routing QGIA output into L2, or treating QGIA output as an autonomous L1 decision trigger, is a finding. Layer architecture reference is mandatory reading before starting this item.
